Definition: from G5143; a wheel (as a runner), i.e. (figuratively) a circuit of physical effects:--course.
BiblicalUsage: James says the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity, defiling the whole body and setting on fire the course of nature. The tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity, defiling the whole body and setting on fire the course of nature, and it is set on fire of hell.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the image is terrifying on purpose: one small member can burn the whole wheel of a life, from birth to death.
